high-school.name: Secondaire - Saint-Stanislas
high-school.description: J'ai obtenu mon CESS de l'enseignement générale au collège Saint-Stanislas, en sciences fortes en immersion anglais. Mon curriculum incluait aussi du Latin et des cours d'Anglais en immersion, ce qui m'a permis de développer de bonnes capacités en langue et en analyse

university.name: Université - UCLouvain
university.description: J'ai commencé un bachelier en sciences informatique à l'école Polytechnique de UCLouvain, porté principalement sur la programmation en Python et Java, l'élaboration d'algorithme et les concepts fondamentaux des sciences informatiques

university-college.name: Haute Ecole - HELHa
university-college.description: J'ai obtenu un bachelier en informatique, orientation développement d'application, at HELHa in Mons. This program allowed me to gain deep technical skills and develop my expertise in programming and project management.

internship.name: Internship - ETNIC
internship.description: I completed a 3-month internship at ETNIC in the R&D department as a fullstack developer, where I participated in the development of a RAG. This internship enabled me to apply my theoretical knowledge in a professional context while working as part of a team on a concrete project.

fastai.name: Ateliers Créactifs - FastAI
fastai.description: Completed a training course on building AI models using Python, PyTorch, and FastAI, focusing on creating, training, and evaluating neural network architectures, with hands-on experience in data preparation, model training, and performance evaluation using metrics like accuracy and ROC curves.

forem-dutch.name: Dutch Language Training - Forem
forem-dutch.description: Completed a series of Dutch language courses at Forem Mons, starting at level A0 with no prior knowledge and progressing through levels A1, A2, and finally achieving B1. Each level was certified by Forem through ELAO testing, providing proficiency in reading, writing, listening, and speaking.

project-engineer-technord.name: Project Engineer - Technord
project-engineer-technord.description: Started my career as a MES Project Engineer at Technord, specializing in industrial digitalization. I work on the deployment and integration of Manufacturing Execution Systems, helping industrial clients optimize and digitize their production processes.
